title: adjudication-entries-carry-a-subject
what: Adjudication entries in the operator inbox carry a subject line so the operator can identify them at a glance without looking up the berth.
how: emit_finding gains an optional subject kwarg included in the finding's data alongside bullets. Each skill door passes it: idea passes the slug, intent passes the what, sorted passes the ticket title. The inbox script's adjudication section shows the subject.
traces_to: Law 5 — the address carries what a mind needs NOW
falsifier: Run cairn operator_inbox after the change. (1) Every adjudication entry created after the change shows a subject line that identifies what the finding is about. (2) An entry that says only 'nothing noticed at capture' with no subject is the failure.
watchme: none, because the existing probe at cairn/tools/operator_inbox/probes/operator_inbox_matches_live_state.py already watches the inbox output

gates_bound.build: emit_finding gains subject, skill doors pass it, inbox displays it
gates_bound.proof: new findings carry subject; inbox format shows it
